descripcion_geo: City in the Shephelah assigned to Dan and ceded to the Levites; repeatedly disputed between Israel and the Philistines.
importancia_estrategica: City in constant litigation between Israel and the Philistines.

historias.titulo: Israel besieged Gibbeton when the king changed
historias.descripcion: When Israel was besieging the Philistine Gibbethon, news of Zimri's conspiracy reached the camp; Omri was proclaimed king there.

historias.titulo: Nadab killed during the siege of Gibbeton
historias.descripcion: King Nadab of Israel was killed by Baasha while Israel was besieging Gibbeton.
Gibbeton was assigned as a Levitical city of the tribe of Dan.

personajes.descripcion: He was proclaimed king in the camp in front of Gibbeton and later founded Samaria.
He murdered King Nadab during the siege of Gibbeton and took the throne.
He was killed during the long Israelite siege of Gibbeton.

contexto_religioso.contexto_lugar: Gibbetón: relevant geographical region in the Old Testament.

judaismo.descripcion: Two changes of dynasty in Israel occurred while Gibbeton was under siege; the disputed city becomes the accidental setting of history.
judaismo.significado_teologico: Two changes of dynasty in Israel occurred while Gibbeton was under siege; the disputed city becomes the accidental setting of history.
